- **Reduce uncertainty first (lightweight):** request your resume + any dealbreakers while sourcing roles in parallel.
- **Reduce remaining work (execution):** create reusable templates, tailor per posting, then batch applications over **5–7 days** prioritizing **Easy Apply/Quick Apply**.

### Key outputs
1) Shortlist of **25–35** matching roles (to ensure 20+ submitted after filters).
2) Master resume + cover letter templates + keyword-tailoring checklist.
3) Per-job tailored resume + customized cover letter set.
4) Submission tracker with **company, role, date, platform, method (Easy/Quick vs full), URL, status/notes**.

### Execution notes
- LinkedIn/Indeed application flows are stateful; applications will be executed in batched browser sessions.
